affected_component: product_jobs.propose_workspace_fixture_candidates reproducibility probe + draft_selfcheck routing + workspace reference repair prompt
invariant: Candidate generation (the draft self-check's ruler) re-runs the reference on the first candidate after a >=2s clock tick and requires the identical tree identity; drift fails closed as WORKSPACE_REFERENCE_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE with path-level divergence kinds (BYTES_DIFFER / ZIP_METADATA_ONLY / MISSING / EXTRA) that route to an evidence-based reference repair, so a golden that cannot be re-derived never reaches confirmation, freeze or preflight.
